Thanks — short runbook notes and a scheduling update from my side: 

- Dry-run: proposed 11/04 02:00–04:00 PT (Ben/Helix infra + Redwood ops). Please confirm availability; this will be a full black-start exercise emulating production traffic.
- Cutover step highlights (excerpt from runbook-draft.md):
  * Pre-cutover: final config freeze at T-24h; backup snapshot (immutable) at T-6h; notify stakeholders at T-2h.
  * Cutover: switch traffic to Redwood routing (maintain old path for 30m observation), then flush caches and run smoke tests.
  * Post-cutover: 2-hour observation window followed by 24-hour elevated monitoring.
- Rollback criteria (draft): repeated 5%+ error rate on tokenization/response, or failed data integrity checks after migration. Rollback approval: Karthik or on-call infra lead + Helix production ops approval.

I’ll upload a revised runbook (runbook-draft.md v1.1) after the dry-run plan is confirmed.
